# Customer Feedback Analysis System Using NLP

This project performs customer feedback analysis using classical NLP techniques.

## Learning Path

1. Text Cleaning
2. Tokenization
3. Stop Words
4. Stemming
5. Lemmatization
6. Bag of Words
7. TF-IDF
8. N-grams
9. Logistic Regression
10. Sentiment Analysis
11. Text Classification
12. Multi-label Classification
13. Precision / Recall / F1
14. Word Embeddings
15. Sentence Embeddings
16. Attention
17. Transformers
18. BERT

## 1. Libraries

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import re

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import MultiLabelBinarizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, f1_score
```

## 2. Dataset

```{python}
data = [
    ("Payment keeps failing", "negative", ["payment"]),
    ("The application is very slow", "negative", ["performance"]),
    ("I love the new dashboard", "positive", ["ui"]),
    ("Support solved my issue quickly", "positive", ["support"]),
    ("Login OTP is not arriving", "negative", ["login"]),
    ("The app is slow and payment fails", "negative", ["performance", "payment"]),
    ("Excellent customer support", "positive", ["support"]),
    ("The service is okay", "neutral", ["general"]),
    ("The latest update is good but payment is failing frequently", "negative", ["payment", "performance"]),
    ("The support team solved my issue very quickly", "positive", ["support"]),
    ("App is extremely slow", "negative", ["performance"]),
    ("The application is okay", "neutral", ["general"]),
    ("Payment gateway crashed during checkout", "negative", ["payment"]),
    ("Login page keeps timing out", "negative", ["login"]),
    ("The new UI looks beautiful", "positive", ["ui"]),
    ("Support team was rude and unhelpful", "negative", ["support"]),
    ("App freezes every time I open it", "negative", ["performance"]),
    ("Payment succeeded but receipt never arrived", "negative", ["payment"]),
    ("OTP arrives fine now, good fix", "positive", ["login"]),
    ("Dashboard redesign is confusing", "negative", ["ui"]),
    ("Customer care resolved my ticket fast", "positive", ["support"]),
    ("Nothing to complain about, works fine", "neutral", ["general"]),
    ("Slow app and OTP delay both happened today", "negative", ["performance", "login"]),
    ("Great job on the payment refund process", "positive", ["payment"])
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["feedback", "sentiment", "categories"])
df.head()
```

## 3. Text Cleaning

```{python}
def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.lower()
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text

df["clean_feedback"] = df["feedback"].apply(clean_text)

df[["feedback", "clean_feedback"]]
```

## 4. Sentiment Classification

```{python}
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    df["clean_feedback"],
    df["sentiment"],
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=df["sentiment"]
)

sentiment_model = Pipeline([
    ("tfidf", TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        stop_words="english"
    )),
    ("clf", LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))
])

sentiment_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = sentiment_model.predict(X_test)

print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("\nClassification Report:\n")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0))
```

## 5. Multi-label Category Preparation

```{python}
mlb = MultiLabelBinarizer()
y_cat = mlb.fit_transform(df["categories"])

print("Category classes:", mlb.classes_)
```

## 6. Category Classification Evaluation

```{python}
Xc_train, Xc_test, yc_train, yc_test = train_test_split(
    df["clean_feedback"],
    y_cat,
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42
)

cat_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english"
)

Xc_train_vec = cat_vectorizer.fit_transform(Xc_train)
Xc_test_vec = cat_vectorizer.transform(Xc_test)

eval_category_model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
)

eval_category_model.fit(Xc_train_vec, yc_train)

yc_pred = eval_category_model.predict(Xc_test_vec)

print("Category classes:", mlb.classes_)
print("Micro F1:", f1_score(yc_test, yc_pred, average="micro", zero_division=0))
print("Macro F1:", f1_score(yc_test, yc_pred, average="macro", zero_division=0))
```

## 7. Train Final Category Model

```{python}
cat_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english"
)

Xc_full_vec = cat_vectorizer.fit_transform(df["clean_feedback"])

category_model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
)

category_model.fit(Xc_full_vec, y_cat)
```

## 8. Keyword Extraction

```{python}
def extract_keywords(text, vectorizer, top_n=3):
    clean = clean_text(text)
    vec = vectorizer.transform([clean])
    scores = vec.toarray()[0]
    terms = vectorizer.get_feature_names_out()

    top_indices = scores.argsort()[::-1][:top_n]

    return [
        terms[i]
        for i in top_indices
        if scores[i] > 0
    ]

extract_keywords(
    "Payment gateway failed after entering the OTP",
    cat_vectorizer
)
```

## 9. Complete Feedback Analysis

```{python}
def analyze_feedback(text, threshold=0.3):
    clean = clean_text(text)

    sentiment = sentiment_model.predict([clean])[0]

    cat_vec = cat_vectorizer.transform([clean])
    probs = category_model.predict_proba(cat_vec)[0]

    predicted_categories = [
        mlb.classes_[i]
        for i, p in enumerate(probs)
        if p >= threshold
    ]

    if not predicted_categories:
        predicted_categories = [
            mlb.classes_[probs.argmax()]
        ]

    keywords = extract_keywords(
        text,
        cat_vectorizer
    )

    print("Feedback:", text)
    print("Sentiment:", sentiment)
    print("Categories:", predicted_categories)
    print("Keywords:", keywords)
    print()

analyze_feedback(
    "The app is very slow and payment keeps failing."
)

analyze_feedback(
    "The support team solved my issue very quickly."
)
```

## 10. Confusion Matrix

```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

cm = confusion_matrix(
    y_test,
    y_pred,
    labels=sentiment_model.classes_
)

plt.figure(figsize=(5, 4))

sns.heatmap(
    cm,
    annot=True,
    fmt="d",
    cmap="Blues",
    xticklabels=sentiment_model.classes_,
    yticklabels=sentiment_model.classes_
)

plt.xlabel("Predicted")
plt.ylabel("Actual")
plt.title("Sentiment Model — Confusion Matrix")
plt.show()
```

## 11. Test With New Feedback

```{python}
new_feedback = [
    "The payment is failing again",
    "The new dashboard looks beautiful",
    "The application is extremely slow",
    "Customer support solved my problem"
]

for text in new_feedback:
    analyze_feedback(text)
```

## Design Choices & Results

**Pipeline:** Text Cleaning → TF-IDF (unigram + bigram, English stopwords removed) → Logistic Regression

### Sentiment Classification

- Accuracy is evaluated on the held-out test split.
- The dataset is intentionally small, with 24 rows.
- The neutral class has fewer examples, so its performance can be weaker.

### Category Classification

- `OneVsRestClassifier` + Logistic Regression is used for multi-label classification.
- `predict_proba` with a `0.3` threshold is used for category selection.
- If no category crosses the threshold, the highest-probability category is selected.

### Keyword Extraction

- TF-IDF term scores from the category vectorizer are used.
- Top 3 keywords are returned for each feedback.

### Known Limitation

The dataset is intentionally small for a beginner-level project. A larger real-world dataset would improve model performance, especially for the neutral sentiment class and category classification.
